-- ── Constants (ref Blizzard_TradeSkillUI.lua:2-11) ────────────────────────────────────────── local TRADE_SKILLS_DISPLAYED = 8 -- TRADE_SKILLS_DISPLAYED (ref l.2) local MAX_TRADE_SKILL_REAGENTS = 8 -- MAX_TRADE_SKILL_REAGENTS (ref l.3) local TRADE_SKILL_HEIGHT = 16 -- TRADE_SKILL_HEIGHT (ref l.4)
-- The recipe-row color table (ref l.6-11), transcribed verbatim including "header" — which is -- UNREACHABLE in v1 (this file's header comment, deviation 1). TradeSkillTypeColor = {} TradeSkillTypeColor["optimal"] = { r = 1.00, g = 0.50, b = 0.25 } TradeSkillTypeColor["medium"] = { r = 1.00, g = 1.00, b = 0.00 } TradeSkillTypeColor["easy"] = { r = 0.25, g = 0.75, b = 0.25 } TradeSkillTypeColor["trivial"] = { r = 0.50, g = 0.50, b = 0.50 } TradeSkillTypeColor["header"] = { r = 1.00, g = 0.82, b = 0 }
-- ── GlobalStrings the ref reads (byte-exact 1.12 enUS, this file's header comment cites the -- extraction command) — chunk-local, the TrainerFrame.xml idiom. ───────────────────────────── local TRADE_SKILL_TITLE = "%s" -- TRADE_SKILL_TITLE (GlobalStrings.lua:4278) local REQUIRES_LABEL = "Requires:" -- REQUIRES_LABEL (3339) local SPELL_REAGENTS = "Reagents: " -- SPELL_REAGENTS (4095) -- trailing space, verbatim local COOLDOWN_REMAINING = "Cooldown remaining:" -- COOLDOWN_REMAINING (864) local CREATE_LABEL = "Create" -- CREATE (871) local CREATE_ALL_LABEL = "Create All" -- CREATE_ALL (874) local EXIT_LABEL = "Exit" -- EXIT (1933) local ALL_SUBCLASSES = "All Subclasses" -- ALL_SUBCLASSES (48) local ALL_INVENTORY_SLOTS = "All Slots" -- ALL_INVENTORY_SLOTS (47)
-- SecondsToTime's plural pairs (ref UIParent.lua:1004-1032 calls GetText("*_ABBR", nil, n)) — -- guarded GLOBALS, BuffFrame.xml's own DAY_ONELETTER_ABBR precedent (a generic UIParent.lua -- utility's own supporting constants, not a window-local label). DAYS_ABBR = DAYS_ABBR or "Day" -- DAYS_ABBR (895) DAYS_ABBR_P1 = DAYS_ABBR_P1 or "Days" -- DAYS_ABBR_P1 (896) HOURS_ABBR = HOURS_ABBR or "Hr" -- HOURS_ABBR (2296) HOURS_ABBR_P1 = HOURS_ABBR_P1 or "Hrs" -- HOURS_ABBR_P1 (2297) MINUTES_ABBR = MINUTES_ABBR or "Min" -- MINUTES_ABBR (2693) MINUTES_ABBR_P1 = MINUTES_ABBR_P1 or "Mins" -- MINUTES_ABBR_P1 (2694) SECONDS_ABBR = SECONDS_ABBR or "Sec" -- SECONDS_ABBR (3405) SECONDS_ABBR_P1 = SECONDS_ABBR_P1 or "Secs" -- SECONDS_ABBR_P1 (3404)
local function pluralAbbr(n, singular, plural) if n == 1 then return singular end return plural end
-- SecondsToTime (ref UIParent.lua:1004-1032) — guarded global (this file's header comment, -- deviation 7): GetText's locale pluralization dispatch collapses to English singular/plural -- directly (UiPanels.xml's StaticPopupTimeUnit is the identical-shaped precedent for the same -- GetText call elsewhere in the reference). if not SecondsToTime then function SecondsToTime(seconds, noSeconds) local time, count = "", 0 seconds = floor(seconds) if seconds > 86400 then local t = floor(seconds / 86400) time = time .. t .. " " .. pluralAbbr(t, DAYS_ABBR, DAYS_ABBR_P1) .. " " seconds = mod(seconds, 86400) count = count + 1 end if seconds > 3600 then local t = floor(seconds / 3600) time = time .. t .. " " .. pluralAbbr(t, HOURS_ABBR, HOURS_ABBR_P1) .. " " seconds = mod(seconds, 3600) count = count + 1 end if count < 2 and seconds >= 60 then local t = floor(seconds / 60) time = time .. t .. " " .. pluralAbbr(t, MINUTES_ABBR, MINUTES_ABBR_P1) .. " " seconds = mod(seconds, 60) count = count + 1 end if count < 2 and seconds > 0 and not noSeconds then time = time .. seconds .. " " .. pluralAbbr(seconds, SECONDS_ABBR, SECONDS_ABBR_P1) .. " " end return time end end
-- BuildColoredListString (ref UIParent.lua:1059-1082) — guarded global (this file's header -- comment, deviation 7): odd args are text, even args say whether it's "met" (white) or not -- (red |cffff2020 ... |r). GetTradeSkillTools' own alternating (name, hasTool) return is -- exactly this shape. Lua-5.0 arg/arg.n replaced with select(), WorldMapFrame.xml's precedent. if not BuildColoredListString then function BuildColoredListString(...) local n = select("#", ...) if n == 0 then return nil end local a1, a2 = select(1, ...) local s if a2 then s = a1 else s = RED_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. a1 .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE end for i = 3, n, 2 do local text, met = select(i, ...) if met then s = s .. ", " .. text else s = s .. ", " .. RED_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. text .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE end end return s end end
-- ── Detail pane ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- No trade skills known at all (ref l.79-89): blank the whole detail pane. Regions on this -- window's own Layers "hide" via SetText("") — TrainerFrame.xml's own convention, which -- predates region Show/Hide (region.rs has the real pair now); equivalent either way. function BenillaTradeSkillFrame_HideDetails() getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillFrameTitleText"):SetText(format(TRADE_SKILL_TITLE, GetTradeSkillLine())) getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillSkillName"):SetText("") getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillSkillIcon"):Hide() getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillSkillIconCount"):SetText("") getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillRequirementLabel"):SetText("") getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillRequirementText"):SetText("") getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillSkillCooldown"):SetText("") for i = 1, MAX_TRADE_SKILL_REAGENTS do getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillReagent" .. i):Hide() end getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillCreateButton"):Disable() getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillCreateAllButton"):Disable() end
-- Fill the detail pane + the rank statusbar for the selected recipe `id` (ref -- TradeSkillFrame_SetSelection, l.181-294, header branch restored — deviation 1, wow-re -- `tradeskill` TU-B). Also the SOURCE of the selection highlight's color (set once here, ref -- l.198-201). GetTradeSkillInfo(id) is called ONCE up top, ref's own shape (l.182) — a header -- click folds its group and returns before ever selecting (ref l.184-192; the ref's own -- Show()/Hide() pair here is dropped, deviation 6's own added note). function BenillaTradeSkillFrame_SetSelection(id) if not id or id == 0 then BenillaTradeSkillFrame.selectedSkill = 0 BenillaTradeSkillFrame_HideDetails() return end local skillName, skillType, numAvailable, isExpanded = GetTradeSkillInfo(id) if skillType == "header" then if isExpanded then CollapseTradeSkillSubClass(id) else ExpandTradeSkillSubClass(id) end return end BenillaTradeSkillFrame.selectedSkill = id SelectTradeSkill(id) if GetTradeSkillSelectionIndex() > GetNumTradeSkills() then return end local color = TradeSkillTypeColor[skillType] if color then getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillHighlight"):SetVertexColor(color.r, color.g, color.b) end
-- General info (ref l.203-212). local skillLineName, skillLineRank, skillLineMaxRank = GetTradeSkillLine() getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillFrameTitleText"):SetText(format(TRADE_SKILL_TITLE, skillLineName)) local rankFrame = getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillRankFrame") getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillRankFrameSkillName"):SetText(skillLineName) rankFrame:SetStatusBarColor(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.5) getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillRankFrameBackground"):SetVertexColor(0.0, 0.0, 0.75, 0.5) rankFrame:SetMinMaxValues(0, skillLineMaxRank) rankFrame:SetValue(skillLineRank) getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillRankFrameSkillRank"):SetText(skillLineRank .. "/" .. skillLineMaxRank)
getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillSkillName"):SetText(skillName) local cooldown = GetTradeSkillCooldown(id) if cooldown then getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillSkillCooldown"):SetText(COOLDOWN_REMAINING .. " " .. SecondsToTime(cooldown)) else getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillSkillCooldown"):SetText("") end
local icon = getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillSkillIcon") icon:Show() icon:SetNormalTexture(GetTradeSkillIcon(id) or BENILLA_FALLBACK_ICON) local iconCount = getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillSkillIconCount") local minMade, maxMade = GetTradeSkillNumMade(id) if maxMade > 1 then if minMade == maxMade then iconCount:SetText(minMade) else iconCount:SetText(minMade .. "-" .. maxMade) end if iconCount:GetWidth() > 39 then iconCount:SetText("~" .. floor((minMade + maxMade) / 2)) end else iconCount:SetText("") end
-- Reagents (ref l.235-272): up to MAX_TRADE_SKILL_REAGENTS, gray-out + creatable gate. local creatable = true local numReagents = GetTradeSkillNumReagents(id) for i = 1, MAX_TRADE_SKILL_REAGENTS do local reagent = getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillReagent" .. i) if i <= numReagents then local reagentName, reagentTexture, need, have = GetTradeSkillReagentInfo(id, i) if not reagentName or not reagentTexture then -- Item template not landed yet for this reagent — hide it, like the ref does -- for any nil reagent (engine API note, decision 0437). reagent:Hide() else reagent:Show() reagent.icon:SetTexture(reagentTexture) reagent.name:SetText(reagentName) have = have or 0 if have < need then reagent.icon:SetVertexColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) reagent.name:SetTextColor(GRAY_FONT_COLOR.r, GRAY_FONT_COLOR.g, GRAY_FONT_COLOR.b) creatable = false else reagent.icon:SetVertexColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) reagent.name:SetTextColor(HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.r, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.g, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.b) end local haveText = have if have >= 100 then haveText = "*" end reagent.count:SetText(haveText .. " /" .. need) end else reagent:Hide() end end
-- Requires: line (ref l.274-281). "Hidden" means both FontStrings blank -- (TrainerFrame.xml's own convention — see BenillaTradeSkillFrame_HideDetails). local spellFocus = BuildColoredListString(GetTradeSkillTools(id)) if spellFocus then getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillRequirementLabel"):SetText(REQUIRES_LABEL) getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillRequirementText"):SetText(spellFocus) else getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillRequirementLabel"):SetText("") getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillRequirementText"):SetText("") end
if creatable then getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillCreateButton"):Enable() getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillCreateAllButton"):Enable() else getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillCreateButton"):Disable() getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillCreateAllButton"):Disable() end
-- Reset the number of items to be created (ref l.293). getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillInputBox"):SetNumber(GetTradeskillRepeatCount()) end
-- ── The list page (ref TradeSkillFrame_Update, l.75-178 — the header/expand-icon tail, -- l.118-127, is restored below at the row loop; the CollapseAll Enable/Disable (l.86/94) and -- the tail texture logic (l.155-178) are restored too, deviation 1 closed this session) ────── function BenillaTradeSkillFrame_Update() local numTradeSkills = GetNumTradeSkills() if numTradeSkills == 0 then BenillaTradeSkillFrame_HideDetails() getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillCollapseAllButton"):Disable() -- ref l.86 else getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillCollapseAllButton"):Enable() -- ref l.94 end
local scrollFrame = getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillListScrollFrame") FauxScrollFrame_Update(scrollFrame, numTradeSkills, TRADE_SKILLS_DISPLAYED, TRADE_SKILL_HEIGHT) local skillOffset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(scrollFrame)
-- The FRAME is what shows/hides/positions (ref l.99/142-143); its texture is only ever -- vertex-coloured (SetSelection, ref l.200). Addressing the texture here instead left the -- glow's frame `hidden="true"` forever, so no selection ever painted (decision 1598) — -- CraftFrame.xml and TrainerFrame.xml both already split the two correctly. local highlight = getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillHighlightFrame") highlight:Hide()
local selection = GetTradeSkillSelectionIndex() for i = 1, TRADE_SKILLS_DISPLAYED do local skillIndex = i + skillOffset local button = getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillSkill" .. i) if skillIndex <= numTradeSkills then local skillName, skillType, numAvailable, isExpanded = GetTradeSkillInfo(skillIndex) if not skillName then button.skillIndex = nil button:Hide() else button.skillIndex = skillIndex local color = TradeSkillTypeColor[skillType] if color then button.name:SetTextColor(color.r, color.g, color.b) end -- Header row (ref l.118-127, wow-re `tradeskill` TU-B): the group name -- verbatim, no "[n]" suffix, the +/- fold icon + its hover glow swapped on -- isExpanded. UnlockHighlight() (ref l.127) is dropped — no native -- Lock/UnlockHighlight (this file's header comment, deviation 7); the -- persistent selection glow below is the separate BenillaTradeSkillHighlight -- texture, never this button's own highlight lock. if skillType == "header" then button.name:SetText(skillName) if isExpanded then button:SetNormalTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-MinusButton-Up") else button:SetNormalTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-PlusButton-Up") end getglobal(button:GetName() .. "Highlight"):SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-PlusButton-Hilight") else button:SetNormalTexture("") getglobal(button:GetName() .. "Highlight"):SetTexture("") if (numAvailable or 0) == 0 then button.name:SetText(" " .. skillName) else button.name:SetText(" " .. skillName .. " [" .. numAvailable .. "]") end end button:Show() -- The selection glow only ever lands on a recipe row — SetSelection never -- selects a header (deviation 1), so `selection` can't be one's index. if selection == skillIndex then highlight:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", button, "TOPLEFT", 0, 0) highlight:Show() end end else button.skillIndex = nil button:Hide() end end
-- The max makeable count for Create All (ref l.166-169's own full-list scan collapses to a -- direct lookup of the selected index — this file's header comment, deviation 6). if selection >= 1 and selection <= numTradeSkills then local _, _, numAvailable = GetTradeSkillInfo(selection) BenillaTradeSkillFrame.numAvailable = numAvailable or 0 else BenillaTradeSkillFrame.numAvailable = 0 end
-- Count headers + how many stay folded (ref l.156-170), to drive the CollapseAll tab's own -- texture below — restored, deviation 1 closed this session. local numHeaders, notExpanded = 0, 0 for i = 1, numTradeSkills do local skillName, skillType, numAvailable, isExpanded = GetTradeSkillInfo(i) if skillName and skillType == "header" then numHeaders = numHeaders + 1 if not isExpanded then notExpanded = notExpanded + 1 end end end -- If all headers are not expanded then show the collapse texture, otherwise the expand one -- (ref l.171-178). local collapseAll = getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillCollapseAllButton") if notExpanded ~= numHeaders then collapseAll.collapsed = nil collapseAll:SetNormalTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-MinusButton-Up") else collapseAll.collapsed = true collapseAll:SetNormalTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-PlusButton-Up") end end
-- A row click selects it OR folds its group (ref TradeSkillSkillButton_OnClick + -- SetSelection's now-restored header branch, deviation 1) — SetSelection itself forks on -- the row's type, this handler doesn't need to. Left-button only. function BenillaTradeSkillSkillButton_OnClick(button, mouseButton) if mouseButton ~= "LeftButton" then return end local index = button.skillIndex if not index then return end BenillaTradeSkillFrame_SetSelection(index) BenillaTradeSkillFrame_Update() end
-- The window's wheel handler (bubbled up the parent chain from a row) → one row via the faux -- kit (TrainerFrame.xml's own note: the engine bubbles a spin up the parent chain, so the -- handler lives on the window, not a child). function BenillaTradeSkillFrame_OnMouseWheel(delta) BenillaFauxScrollFrame_OnMouseWheel(getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillListScrollFrame"), delta) end
-- ── The CollapseAll tab (ref TradeSkillCollapseAllButton_OnClick, l.303-312) — toggles between -- Expand/CollapseTradeSkillSubClass(0), the ALL-groups pseudo-index (deviation 1, engine module -- doc), using the button's own `.collapsed` flag (re-derived every Update() from the real -- header states above, so it stays honest regardless of how a fold happened). The ref's raw -- `TradeSkillListScrollFrameScrollBar:SetValue(0)` becomes this file's own -- `FauxScrollFrame_SetOffset(...,0)` wrapper (already this file's own Show/OnEvent -- convention). No direct `BenillaTradeSkillFrame_Update()` call — the ref doesn't call one -- either; `CollapseTradeSkillSubClass`/`ExpandTradeSkillSubClass` raise the engine's touched -- flag, answered with `TRADE_SKILL_UPDATE` the same frame (header comment, deviation 1). ────── function BenillaTradeSkillCollapseAllButton_OnClick(self) if self.collapsed then self.collapsed = nil ExpandTradeSkillSubClass(0) else self.collapsed = true FauxScrollFrame_SetOffset(getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillListScrollFrame"), 0) CollapseTradeSkillSubClass(0) end end
-- ── The SubClass filter dropdown (ref TradeSkillSubClassDropDown_*, l.314-358). Every call -- passes the dropdown frame explicitly by NAME (TrainerFrame.xml's own -- BenillaTrainerFilterDropDown calling-convention precedent) rather than riding the bare `this` -- fallback UIDropDownMenu_Initialize/_SetWidth/_SetSelectedID allow. ───────────────────────── function BenillaTradeSkillSubClassDropDown_OnLoad() UIDropDownMenu_Initialize(BenillaTradeSkillSubClassDropDown, BenillaTradeSkillSubClassDropDown_Initialize) UIDropDownMenu_SetWidth(120, BenillaTradeSkillSubClassDropDown) UIDropDownMenu_SetSelectedID(BenillaTradeSkillSubClassDropDown, 1) end
function BenillaTradeSkillSubClassDropDown_OnShow() UIDropDownMenu_Initialize(BenillaTradeSkillSubClassDropDown, BenillaTradeSkillSubClassDropDown_Initialize) if GetTradeSkillSubClassFilter(0) then UIDropDownMenu_SetSelectedID(BenillaTradeSkillSubClassDropDown, 1) end end
function BenillaTradeSkillSubClassDropDown_Initialize() BenillaTradeSkillFilterFrame_LoadSubClasses(GetTradeSkillSubClasses()) end
-- ref TradeSkillFilterFrame_LoadSubClasses(...) (l.331-358): Lua-5.0 arg/arg.n → select() (this -- file's header comment, deviation 7's BuildColoredListString precedent). function BenillaTradeSkillFilterFrame_LoadSubClasses(...) local n = select("#", ...) local allChecked = GetTradeSkillSubClassFilter(0) if n > 1 then local info = {} info.text = ALL_SUBCLASSES info.func = BenillaTradeSkillSubClassDropDownButton_OnClick info.checked = allChecked UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(info) end
local checked for i = 1, n do local name = select(i, ...) if allChecked and n > 1 then checked = nil UIDropDownMenu_SetText(ALL_SUBCLASSES, BenillaTradeSkillSubClassDropDown) else checked = GetTradeSkillSubClassFilter(i) if checked then UIDropDownMenu_SetText(name, BenillaTradeSkillSubClassDropDown) end end local info = {} info.text = name info.func = BenillaTradeSkillSubClassDropDownButton_OnClick info.checked = checked UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(info) end end
-- ── The InvSlot filter dropdown (ref TradeSkillInvSlotDropDown_*, l.360-404) — the SubClass -- dropdown's own exact shape. ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── function BenillaTradeSkillInvSlotDropDown_OnLoad() UIDropDownMenu_Initialize(BenillaTradeSkillInvSlotDropDown, BenillaTradeSkillInvSlotDropDown_Initialize) UIDropDownMenu_SetWidth(120, BenillaTradeSkillInvSlotDropDown) UIDropDownMenu_SetSelectedID(BenillaTradeSkillInvSlotDropDown, 1) end
function BenillaTradeSkillInvSlotDropDown_OnShow() UIDropDownMenu_Initialize(BenillaTradeSkillInvSlotDropDown, BenillaTradeSkillInvSlotDropDown_Initialize) if GetTradeSkillInvSlotFilter(0) then UIDropDownMenu_SetSelectedID(BenillaTradeSkillInvSlotDropDown, 1) end end
function BenillaTradeSkillInvSlotDropDown_Initialize() BenillaTradeSkillFilterFrame_LoadInvSlots(GetTradeSkillInvSlots()) end
-- ref TradeSkillFilterFrame_LoadInvSlots(...) (l.377-404) — the SubClass loader's own shape. function BenillaTradeSkillFilterFrame_LoadInvSlots(...) local n = select("#", ...) local allChecked = GetTradeSkillInvSlotFilter(0) if n > 1 then local info = {} info.text = ALL_INVENTORY_SLOTS info.func = BenillaTradeSkillInvSlotDropDownButton_OnClick info.checked = allChecked UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(info) end
local checked for i = 1, n do local name = select(i, ...) if allChecked and n > 1 then checked = nil UIDropDownMenu_SetText(ALL_INVENTORY_SLOTS, BenillaTradeSkillInvSlotDropDown) else checked = GetTradeSkillInvSlotFilter(i) if checked then UIDropDownMenu_SetText(name, BenillaTradeSkillInvSlotDropDown) end end local info = {} info.text = name info.func = BenillaTradeSkillInvSlotDropDownButton_OnClick info.checked = checked UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(info) end end
-- The two menu-row handlers (ref l.406-414): each fires as a row's `info.func`, invoked by -- UIDropDownMenuButton_OnClick as `func(this.arg1, this.arg2)` with the REAL global `this` -- bound to the clicked row (UIDropDownMenu.xml's own calling convention, confirmed live in -- this engine — header comment, deviation 1) — no `self` parameter is passed, so `this` is -- REQUIRED here, not a style choice. function BenillaTradeSkillSubClassDropDownButton_OnClick() UIDropDownMenu_SetSelectedID(BenillaTradeSkillSubClassDropDown, this:GetID()) SetTradeSkillSubClassFilter(this:GetID() - 1, 1, 1) end
function BenillaTradeSkillInvSlotDropDownButton_OnClick() UIDropDownMenu_SetSelectedID(BenillaTradeSkillInvSlotDropDown, this:GetID()) SetTradeSkillInvSlotFilter(this:GetID() - 1, 1, 1) end
-- ── The detail product icon (ref TradeSkillSkillIcon OnEnter/OnClick, l.563-590 — the -- Ctrl/Shift dressing-room/chat-link branches dropped, deviation 3) ───────────────────────── function BenillaTradeSkillSkillIcon_OnEnter(button) local selected = BenillaTradeSkillFrame.selectedSkill or 0 if selected ~= 0 then GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetTradeSkillItem(selected) GameTooltip:Show() end end
-- ── The reagent slots (ref TradeSkillItemTemplate OnEnter, l.13-17 — the dressing-room/ -- chat-link OnClick branches dropped, deviation 3) ───────────────────────────────────────── function BenillaTradeSkillReagent_OnLoad(button, index) button.reagentIndex = index local n = button:GetName() button.icon = getglobal(n .. "Icon") button.name = getglobal(n .. "Name") button.count = getglobal(n .. "Count") end
function BenillaTradeSkillReagent_OnEnter(button) GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_TOPLEFT") GameTooltip:SetTradeSkillItem(BenillaTradeSkillFrame.selectedSkill, button.reagentIndex) GameTooltip:Show() end
-- ── Create / Create All / the repeat-count input (ref l.668-837) ─────────────────────────── function BenillaTradeSkillCreateButton_OnClick() local box = getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillInputBox") DoTradeSkill(BenillaTradeSkillFrame.selectedSkill, box:GetNumber()) box:ClearFocus() end
function BenillaTradeSkillCreateAllButton_OnClick() local box = getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillInputBox") box:SetNumber(BenillaTradeSkillFrame.numAvailable) DoTradeSkill(BenillaTradeSkillFrame.selectedSkill, BenillaTradeSkillFrame.numAvailable) box:ClearFocus() end
function BenillaTradeSkillCancelButton_OnClick() HideUIPanel(getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillFrame")) end
function BenillaTradeSkillFrameIncrement_OnClick() local box = getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillInputBox") if box:GetNumber() < 100 then box:SetNumber(box:GetNumber() + 1) end box:ClearFocus() end
function BenillaTradeSkillFrameDecrement_OnClick() local box = getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillInputBox") if box:GetNumber() > 0 then box:SetNumber(box:GetNumber() - 1) end box:ClearFocus() end
-- ── The window lifecycle (MerchantFrame.xml/TrainerFrame.xml's own shape) ────────────────── function BenillaTradeSkillFrame_OnLoad(frame) frame.selectedSkill = 0 frame.numAvailable = 0 frame:RegisterEvent("TRADE_SKILL_SHOW") frame:RegisterEvent("TRADE_SKILL_UPDATE") frame:RegisterEvent("TRADE_SKILL_CLOSE") frame:RegisterEvent("UPDATE_TRADESKILL_RECAST") -- Registered per the ref (TradeSkillFrame_OnLoad l.43); this engine may not fire it yet — -- forward-compatible, harmless (TalentFrame.xml's own identical posture for this event). frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_PORTRAIT_UPDATE")
local scrollFrame = getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillListScrollFrame") scrollFrame.updateFunc = BenillaTradeSkillFrame_Update
-- The EditBox:SetNumber engine-gap shim (this file's header comment, deviation 7): patched -- onto this ONE instance so every call site above reads exactly like the reference. local box = getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillInputBox") function box:SetNumber(n) self:SetText(tostring(floor(n or 0))) end end
-- Fresh session paint (ref TradeSkillFrame_Show, l.15-34 — the dropdown Close/Show dance, -- l.16-20, is restored below: deviation 1 closed this session, the dropdowns ship). Hide() -- then Show() re-fires each dropdown's own OnShow handler, forcing a fresh re-init/re-sync of -- its selected id every time the window opens — the ref's own intent, not just a paint no-op. function BenillaTradeSkillFrame_Show(frame) CloseDropDownMenus() getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillSubClassDropDown"):Hide() getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillSubClassDropDown"):Show() getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillInvSlotDropDown"):Hide() getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillInvSlotDropDown"):Show() getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillCreateButton"):Disable() getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillCreateAllButton"):Disable() if GetTradeSkillSelectionIndex() == 0 then BenillaTradeSkillFrame_SetSelection(GetFirstTradeSkill()) else BenillaTradeSkillFrame_SetSelection(GetTradeSkillSelectionIndex()) end FauxScrollFrame_SetOffset(getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillListScrollFrame"), 0) SetPortraitTexture(getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillFramePortrait"), "player") BenillaTradeSkillFrame_Update() ShowUIPanel(frame) end
function BenillaTradeSkillFrame_OnEvent(frame) if event == "TRADE_SKILL_SHOW" then BenillaTradeSkillFrame_Show(frame) elseif event == "TRADE_SKILL_UPDATE" then -- ref l.54-62: re-anchor the selection if it's fallen off a (possibly shorter) list. local selection = GetTradeSkillSelectionIndex() if selection > 1 and selection <= GetNumTradeSkills() then BenillaTradeSkillFrame_SetSelection(selection) elseif GetNumTradeSkills() > 0 then BenillaTradeSkillFrame_SetSelection(GetFirstTradeSkill()) FauxScrollFrame_SetOffset(getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillListScrollFrame"), 0) end BenillaTradeSkillFrame_Update() elseif event == "TRADE_SKILL_CLOSE" then HideUIPanel(frame) elseif event == "UPDATE_TRADESKILL_RECAST" then getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillInputBox"):SetNumber(GetTradeskillRepeatCount()) elseif event == "UNIT_PORTRAIT_UPDATE" then if arg1 == "player" then SetPortraitTexture(getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillFramePortrait"), "player") end end end
function BenillaTradeSkillFrameCloseButton_OnClick() HideUIPanel(getglobal("BenillaTradeSkillFrame")) end
